scope: Explicit synthetic completed-case local checkpoints; final choice is made with the real UI and persisted by the real solo simulation. No claim of physical sector traversal or real multiplayer transport.

outcome.title: Open Mandate
outcome.description: The council releases the case, removes the administration through a recorded vote and appoints an interim coalition under published contracts. Noor prints Samar’s disclosures too. Meera waits until the ceremony ends, then hands you tomorrow’s delivery list. The new government must answer to the same rules.

outcome.title: A New Name on the Door
outcome.description: The administration falls, but Samar’s backers gain a private channel. You seal their annex and keep the lucrative dispatches. Noor refuses to endorse the deal. On Republic Times, Grnab Aoswami announces a fresh beginning beneath familiar sponsor credits. The names on the doors change; the favors continue.
